objective: Talk about the weather — the universal opener, and in this region a real topic: heat, rain, and which season everything happens in.

grammar.point: Weather sentences need no verb either
grammar.body: إلجَوّ حِلو, إلدُّنْيا شوب — subject then description, nothing in between. Same nominal sentence, new vocabulary.
